title: Cross-adapter conformance and deterministic replay harness

mismatch.missing: adapter IDs grouped by missing capability

invariants: All adapters expose one bounded normalized event and capability assertion shape.
Every event is bound to AR-0022 revision 1, one session/worktree, and its adapter identity.
Replaying the same normalized records produces byte-identical records and digests.
Capability mismatch is explicit, non-executing, and non-mutating; it is never treated as success.
Unknown fields, stale revisions, duplicate events, privacy-bearing values, and cross-adapter bindings fail closed.

privacy.projection: identities, bounded states, capability names, counts, and digests only

limitations: The harness validates supplied synthetic observations only; it does not launch Codex, OpenCode, OpenDesk, a provider, process, network, LLM, or tool.
Conformance and replay do not prove provider availability, authorization, model behavior, filesystem isolation, hosted CI, Coordinator truth, or runtime success.
Provider-specific contracts remain authoritative for native mapping and lifecycle semantics.
